g.title: ECU_16PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 16-pin aux breakout
CAN H/L shared with 8HP CAN — see CAN_BUS_JUNCTION in maxxecu-m52.wv.

g.title: W_CAN_GAUGES
g.text: Twisted pair, 22 AWG. Tap from cabin-side CAN junction shared with 8HP.

g.title: GAUGE_S
g.text: Verify connector pinout from Gauge.S E36 documentation

Receives MaxxECU Default 1.3 CAN output at 500 kbps. MTune: CAN :: Default CAN output :: MaxxECU Default 1.3. Config file: maxxecu.json (gauge-s-maxxecu repo). Verify Gauge.S internal 120Ω termination; add external if absent. Power: fused ignition-switched +12V (1A fuse sufficient).
